summary: Illumina filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $300 million public offering of 4.950% notes due 2029, issued under an existing indenture and an officer's certificate. Proceeds, with cash on hand, will repay $500 million of 4.650% notes maturing September 2026. The offering is a routine debt refinancing on Form S-3, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, or strategic event occurred. Watch for any subsequent capital allocation announcements, but this filing is purely a financing transaction.
